unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #1 "A Nano (XNO) rail for the non-private class of buyers — settlement is the block, so a per-call transfer needs no deposit and no cumulative voucher" on oynozan/z402, verified OPEN. Argued from its README: shielded Zcash, one deposit + cumulative voucher per session so nothing goes on chain per call; XNO needs no deposit/voucher/facilitator for the class of buyers who do not need the shield, block is per-call receipt. Honest boundary: Nano is not a privacy rail and not a Zcash replacement. Carry: github.com/dhyabi2/nano-invoice. URL: https://github.com/oynozan/z402/issues/1
